pull_request.title: Calorimeter: Si-W ECAL barrel prototype
pull_request.head: codex/siw-barrel-prototype
pull_request.body:
## Executive summary

Builds the detailed **isolated Si–W ECAL barrel prototype** requested after PR70: compact square sensor boards, physical guards/supports, PCB/ASIC/thermal stacks, shared lane interfaces and common cooling. Sixteen sectors and 48 sampling layers retain the existing barrel envelope. Axial service joints alternate by one board pitch to avoid an uninterrupted aligned dead band.

Native construction, mass/material/readout and complete overlaps pass at 10 nm; all module electrode addresses and three sparse saved-hit Geant4 cases pass. The proposed hardware totals **299.003 t**, including **119.693 t copper**, with a **188.401 kW continuous-power hypothesis**. These costs, remaining cracks and missing external service routes require engineering review before integration. DES031 remains DRAFT/PROTOTYPE; no production or performance acceptance is claimed.

**Dependency:** stacked on [PR70](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/70) so this diff contains the barrel follow-up. PR70 now targets main after ordinary integration of merged PR69. Merge PR70 first, then retarget this PR to main if GitHub has not done so automatically.

## Change

- Adds [DES031](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/2776266570dda13386a16863e5b0e97432f27217/docs/design/DES-031-siw-barrel-prototype.md), centralized parameters, reproducible export and an isolated DD4hep factory.
- Packs 359,904 full 90 mm sensors on 94 mm boards: 92,135,424 pads and 15,648 shared interfaces. Seven 1000 mm slabs and 276/468 mm end slabs preserve the envelope with alternating −96/+96 mm phases.
- Models inactive guards, absorber ownership, ASIC/thermal/PCB material, cold plates, coolant holes/runs, frames and interface components. Headers, ports and external power/data routes remain absent.
- Adds source-bound slab/sector and native material/layer-count figures, executed validation JSONs, independent finite-ray comparison and project/session records. Original native evidence is preserved before validator strengthening.

![Detailed barrel and one slab](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/2776266570dda13386a16863e5b0e97432f27217/docs/design/figures/DES-031/barrel-layout.png)

## Executed validation

- 32 hardware controls pass, including adverse prism/packing/cooling/ownership checks.
- Existing DD4hep1.38/ROOT6.40.04 factory builds. Complete native audit: 14,406 shape checks, 37,684 placement checks, 359,904 physical sensor IDs; **zero overlaps at 1e−5 mm**, seed31, over roughly9.2 million physical nodes.
- Supplemental readout: 552 module addresses,141,312 electrode references and4,416 boundary ties pass.
- Native/analytic mass and constituent composition agree. All60 independent finite-silicon rays match ROOT; five centre-plane boundary differences are explained.
- Three single-board/single-layer 10 GeV muon fixtures (seeds45/46/47,zero field) save positive-energy hits with expected parent/pad IDs. Complete barrel transport, response/calibration and ACTS conversion remain open.
- Generated SVG/PNG figures visually checked; project records,181 paired journals, token Pages build and final staged whitespace checks pass. Exact current root/child token counters are unavailable and are recorded as unknown.

Independent read-only SysArch and PhysVal assessments identify the exact geometry revision. Validator section/offset/scale and helper-identity findings were fixed and the complete native audit rerun without relaxing gates. The existing Spack setup registry has changed fingerprints; installed libraries/runtime/datasets were actually reverified. No new software dependencies were adopted.

[Executed results and limitations](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/2776266570dda13386a16863e5b0e97432f27217/docs/validation/DES-031/results.md) · [Design budget and figures](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/2776266570dda13386a16863e5b0e97432f27217/docs/design/DES-031-siw-barrel-prototype.md#executed-prototype-budgets).

[PR72](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/72) supplies the separately requested README/layout main page and links this barrel, PR70 and PR64 with future layout maintenance.

```json
{
  "id": "LAYOUT-PubDoc",
  "role": "PubDoc",
  "input_revision": "7c6d453fef12c3207b468c4fc99633fb393072a4",
  "inputs": [
    "README.md",
    "AGENTS.md",
    "docs/design/DES-025-tracker-dd4hep-gen3.md",
    "docs/design/DES-029-calorimeter-assemblies.md",
    "project/tracking.json"
  ],
  "mode": "write",
  "writable_paths": [
    "README.md",
    "AGENTS.md",
    ".github/pull_request_template.md",
    "docs/layouts/README.md",
    "docs/layouts/LAYOUT-001-tracker-3t-siw.md",
    "docs/layouts/LAYOUT-001.json",
    "docs/layouts/figures/LAYOUT-001-rz.svg",
    "docs/layouts/figures/LAYOUT-001-rz.png",
    "tools/layout_overview/draw.py"
  ],
  "task": "Create the separately requested concise Markdown main page of current layout candidates accessible prominently from root README. One human-selected candidate: current tracker, inner3T solenoid (open PR64), SiW ECAL endcap(open PR70) and forthcoming detailed SiW barrel(PR71 requested; coordinator provides final URL), HCAL rough outline only, no FCal or muon system/muon magnets yet. Main page shows clickable RZ preview linking to a very concise feature page with decision/DES/PR links. Show both +/-z, real envelope scales, tracker (prefer actual recorded sensitive planes), distinguish current component geometry from conditional planning outlines and absent systems. Read extra exact sources with git show: solenoid4e44d7c650ac0a2931f7fc1637b5b3f2dfbe4c95 and edge sensors5664d16aea2df36222dc0099ba18594cf506304d; cite their revisions. You may inspect source files needed to obtain original plotted tracker planes, but do not claim new simulation. Preserve open status and no engineering sign-off. No new dependencies or packages. Standard-library SVG is allowed for this engineering drawing, or existing matplotlib if present. Record named geometry inputs and reproducible draw command in LAYOUT-001.json. Add durable future main-page maintenance rule to AGENTS and a focused PR-template checkbox: update candidate page/view/links when approved changes are merged into a layout prototype; merger alone grants no engineering sign-off. Do not conflate inherited ODD full-detector geometry with this selected candidate or show absent systems. Work only in this worktree. Do not commit, push, create PR, message tasks or start other agents.",
  "deliverable": "Owned Markdown/overview inputs and reproducible RZ drawing plus concise cited handoff, changes and actual checks to coordinator. Coordinator owns logging/project records/PR creation and fills PR71 exact link.",
  "completion": "All owned files coherent, sources/revisions pinned and statuses accurate; generated SVG inspected structurally and PNG visually if renderer available, documentation links checked. Clearly report unavailable rendering or source data instead of inventing dimensions."
}
```

events.text:
BARREL-SysArch read5664d16 and primary CALICE source under main7c6d453
instructions. Independent checks support retained sixteen-sector/48-layer
geometry, compact94 mm boards,6/7/8 columns, seven1000 mm slabs and short ends;
minimum PCB side clearance1.440 mm. A centered short grid collided with the
40 mm bay when preserving5 mm frames;5 mm inward shift leaves3 mm clearance.
359904 sensors,92135424 channels,15648 complete-lane interfaces give188.40 kW
under inherited continuous hypotheses. Headers/ports cannot be inferred from
material-filled allocations. The sector-centre eta0 ray samples only22 layers.
No native/thermal/performance qualification was supplied by that contribution.

Coordinator's aligned control exposed an entirely blind eta0.25 band. Before
extending implementation, DES031 records an unsigned physical-joint staggering
choice:alternate−96/+96 mm slab phases, retaining board count and envelope,
with276/468 mm end-slab families exchanged between ends. The central sensor row
remains present. This is a separate coordinator amendment, not an independently
reviewed SysArch conclusion. Native checks and separate PhysVal review follow.

Initial script/export failures were corrected before any scientific evidence:
a duplicated center_mm keyword prevented export; a unit test confused radial
cold-plate thickness with axial prism extrusion, and a zero-shift negative fixture
failed generic positivity before its intended bay check. The tests now check
actual radial vertices and a positive1 mm inward shift that physically overlaps
its bay. No tolerance or production input was relaxed.

All30 hardware controls pass, including eight new packing/cooling/ownership/
crack controls. The new standalone factory compiles against verified DD4hep1.38;
CMake reports upstream policy/CLHEP warnings, preserved without suppression.
No new dependencies. Native execution remains pending at this initial source
commit; results are not claimed from successful compilation.
